errorBoundary.title: This page encountered an error
errorBoundary.description: Please reload the page. If the problem continues, return to the home page and try again.

forbidden.title: Access denied
forbidden.description: You do not have permission to open this page. If you believe this is a mistake, contact your system administrator.

notFound.title: Page not found
notFound.description: The address you requested does not exist or has been moved.

tooManyRequests.title: Too many requests
tooManyRequests.description: You have sent too many requests in a short time. Wait a moment and try again.
tooManyRequests.descriptionWithRetry: You have sent too many requests in a short time. Try again in {{seconds}} seconds.

serverError.title: Something went wrong
serverError.description: The system ran into a problem while processing your request. Please try again in a little while.

previewError: The preview could not be loaded. You can still download this file.
networkError: A network problem occurred. Check your connection and try again.
unexpectedResponse: The application received a response it could not process. Please try again.
actionFailed: The action could not be completed. Please try again.
